implementation_notes: Name types and methods after the domain concept in the casing convention of the language (PascalCase types, camelCase methods), and avoid `Manager`/`Handler`/`Helper` — these are the words that mark a lost ubiquitous language.
idiom_name: domain nouns as type names, domain verbs as method names
code_sketch: class CreditNote { public: Money refundableAmount() const; };   // not NotesHandler2::getAmount
pitfalls: Anonymous namespaces hiding a class whose name carries the domain term
